_comment: 2-FSK 500 baud 200-4000 Hz works reliably with USB mic. Higher baud rates cause sporadic bit errors on the 3050 Hz tone. USB mic's usable frequency range: ~200-3000 Hz (rolls off above 3000 Hz).

results.next: Test 223B payload (fits 1 RS block) for ~279 bps throughput

notes: Soft sync search threshold: 5/8 bytes matching. Detection threshold: 0.03. Higher baud rates fail due to FFT bin spacing at 64-48 samples.
